purpose: Indexing policy consumed by tools.agent_search and agents; not native OpenCode configuration

repository.table_selection: shared logical corpus from normalized upstream URL, main, and committed profile path; --table overrides with ownership checks
repository.source: Git tree and blobs at an exact commit fetched from the configured upstream main; source and policy never read from working-tree files
repository.chunking: Python/Rust symbols and Markdown headings; split large units without losing parent context
repository.freshness: published main commit/tree, Git blob IDs, file SHA256, immutable generation and atomic manifest pointer; report integrity separately from bounded upstream currency

document_identity.rename_or_move: replace old anchor with new path/name; preserve reusable content embeddings when payloads match
document_identity.ambiguous_anchor: resolve explicitly; do not choose by old line number

embedding_cache.chunker_change: rechunk under the new version/settings; reconcile membership and reuse identical payloads

edit_lifecycle.authority: indexed main is the discovery baseline; current task checkout is authoritative for edits and reviews
edit_lifecycle.writer: one managed writer per shared upstream corpus; agents query and resolve locally
edit_lifecycle.refresh_boundary: MCP mount and five-minute upstream checks; explicit sync fetches main
edit_lifecycle.refresh_scope: selected committed main files; reuse unchanged payloads and reconcile additions, edits, renames, and deletions
edit_lifecycle.branch_delta: inspect git diff <indexed-commit>, staged/unstaged edits, renames/deletions, and relevant untracked files; search/read current source
edit_lifecycle.untracked_files: local discovery only; never enter the shared main corpus
edit_lifecycle.read_only_agents: resolve main hits and branch deltas within assigned scope; report unavailable retrieval to the caller
edit_lifecycle.unavailable_refresh: serve last complete main snapshot with explicit upstream unknown/behind status; use local source when no complete snapshot exists

implementation.mode: committed-main reconciliation on mount and bounded periodic fetch; no filesystem watcher
implementation.ownership: shared normalized upstream/main/profile identity, writer lock, immutable physical generations, and atomic publication pointer
implementation.embedding_cache: reuse exact payload/model keys from the published generation or validated legacy vector cache
implementation.mcp_mode: project-local reader honors vector/fts/hybrid and reports freshness
implementation.mount_hook: tools.agent_search.mcp lifespan ensures fetched main is indexed, including populated corpora; refresh every 300 seconds while mounted

implementation_candidate.engine: CocoIndex with its LanceDB target connector
implementation_candidate.status: deferred: current CocoIndex LanceDB extra requires LanceDB >=0.34 and Python >=3.11; checkpoint writer uses server-compatible LanceDB 0.21.2

articles.processed_full_text: explicit external source root with a provenance manifest; not recursive PDF discovery
articles.chunking: paper/section/page units, preserving equations and table/figure captions with their context
articles.freshness: paper ID, source edition/version, source SHA256, extraction version, verified locators

required: stable document anchors, content-keyed embedding reuse, and changed/deleted source replacement
committed-main snapshot provenance, atomic publication, and local branch-delta resolution
FTS index maintenance and health reporting
connector_upgrade.ann_policy: Benchmark exact scan first; introduce a version-supported ANN index only for measured latency, and compare recall against exact results
